message.content:
A vertical editorial illustration features three men in dark olive-green uniforms and black caps, viewed from behind. They stand side-by-side against a muted teal-gray background. At the bottom, a fourth person’s arm, clad in a dark suit with a light-blue cuff, extends from the left. This hand offers a thick stack of gray and white paper currency towards the middle uniformed man. The middle man’s right hand is behind his back, holding a small, rectangular, rust-red shipping container.

Text overlays the scene. At the top, the red word "TEMPO" is partially obscured by the men's heads. Above it, black text reads "Jumpalitan Defisit Anggaran H.76" and "Animasi Lokal Kian Berkibar H.44." A white box in the upper right contains a barcode, QR code, and publication details. Centered in bold white capital letters is "JALUR FULUS BARANG SELUNDUPAN," followed by a paragraph of smaller white text starting with "Komisi Pemberantasan Korupsi mengungkap suap pengusaha kontainer barang impor..." and ending with "H.60." Thin red lettering beneath "TEMPO" reads "DIBACA DA...". The currency notes feature a circular design and the number "100."
